title: GraphQL Hello World
description: Build a simple GraphQL API with a hello query that returns a greeting, supporting both POST and GET queries.

steps.title: Hello query via POST
steps.description: Create a POST /graphql endpoint that accepts a query { hello } and returns 200 with data.hello.
hints: Use express-graphql or graphql-http to mount a GraphQL endpoint
Define a schema with a Query type containing a hello field

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from graphene import ObjectType, String, Schema
from fastapi_gql import GQL

app = FastAPI()
port = 3000

class Query(ObjectType):
    hello = String()

    def resolve_hello(self, info):
        return 'Hello, world!'

schema = Schema(query=Query)
GQL(app, schema=schema)

steps.title: Query with argument
steps.description: Add a greet query that accepts a name argument: { greet(name: "World") } returning 'Hello, World!'.
hints: Add a new field 'greet' to the Query type
The field takes a String argument 'name'
The resolver uses the name argument to return 'Hello, {name}!'

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from graphene import ObjectType, String, Schema, Argument
from fastapi_gql import GQL

app = FastAPI()
port = 3000

class Query(ObjectType):
    hello = String()
    greet = String(name=Argument(String, required=True))

    def resolve_hello(self, info):
        return 'Hello, world!'

    def resolve_greet(self, info, name):
        return f'Hello, {name}!'

schema = Schema(query=Query)
GQL(app, schema=schema)

steps.title: GET query support
steps.description: Support GET /graphql?query={hello} that returns the same result as the POST endpoint.
hints: Parse query parameters from the URL when method is GET
Execute the query and return the result

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from graphene import ObjectType, String, Schema, Argument
from fastapi_gql import GQL

app = FastAPI()
port = 3000

class Query(ObjectType):
    hello = String()
    greet = String(name=Argument(String, required=True))

    def resolve_hello(self, info):
        return 'Hello, world!'

    def resolve_greet(self, info, name):
        return f'Hello, {name}!'

schema = Schema(query=Query)
GQL(app, schema=schema)

@app.get('/graphql')
async def graphql_get(query: str):
    result = await schema.execute(query)
    return result.data
